podman_path.description: Specify an alternate path to podman binary

podman_args.description: Custom global arguments to be passed to `podman`

pod_args.description: Custom arguments to be passed to `podman pod`

podman_pull_args.description: Custom arguments to be passed to `podman pull`

podman_push_args.description: Custom arguments to be passed to `podman push`

podman_build_args.description: Custom arguments to be passed to `podman build`

podman_inspect_args.description: Custom arguments to be passed to `podman inspect`

podman_run_args.description: Custom arguments to be passed to `podman run`

podman_start_args.description: Custom arguments to be passed to `podman start`

podman_stop_args.description: Custom arguments to be passed to `podman stop`

podman_rm_args.description: Custom arguments to be passed to `podman rm`

podman_volume_args.description: Custom arguments to be passed to `podman volume`

project_name.description: Specify an alternate project name (default: directory name)

no_ansi.description: Do not print ANSI control characters

no_cleanup.description: Do not stop and remove existing pod & containers

dry_run.description: No action; perform a simulation of commands

parallel.description: Run tasks in parallel (0 for sequential)

compose_files.description: List of compose files to use (specified via -f/--file)
